title: Home
getStartedDescription: Four steps, about a minute. Nothing is charged until you run a paid tool.

providers.openrouter: Hundreds of chat, image, video and speech models behind one key.
providers.fal: Fast image and video models such as FLUX, Kling and Nano Banana.
providers.replicate: Run open models for images, video, speech and music.
providers.gemini: Google's image, video, music and transcription models.
providers.elevenlabs: Speech, music, dubbing, transcription and voice isolation.
providers.local: ffmpeg, ComfyUI, Ollama and Whisper on this computer. No key needed.

provider.offLink: Off: turn on in Keys & packs

connect.title: Connect your agent
connect.summaryTodo: Paste one snippet into Claude, Cursor or another agent.
connect.waiting: Waiting for your agent. This updates by itself.
connect.body: Your agent gets this server's tools once you add it. Pick your agent, copy the snippet, then restart or reload the agent.

goal.title: Say what you want to do
goal.body: Pick a goal to see what this computer still needs for it. Free options that keep your files here come first; nothing installs until you approve it.

key.title: Add one key
key.body: One provider key unlocks its image, video and speech tools. You can skip this: free and local tools work without a key.

try.title: Run a tool in the playground
try.summaryDone: Done. Anything a tool makes shows up in the Library.
try.summaryTodo: Fill in a short form and press Run.
try.bodyStatus: Start with the free status check. It runs on this computer and costs nothing.
try.bodyImage: Make an image with {provider}: type a prompt and press Run. What it makes lands in the Library.
try.bodyTool: Try a {provider} tool: fill in the form and press Run. Files it makes land in the Library.

goalSummary.picked: {title}. Its setup plan is on the Software page.
goalSummary.skipped: Skipped. Ask your agent to call setup_plan any time.
goalSummary.prompt: Pick what you want to do; see what this computer still needs.

keySummary.skipped: Skipped. Free and local tools work without a key.
keySummary.prompt: One key unlocks image, video and speech tools.

checklist.doneBody: Ask your agent for an image or a voice-over; it runs here.
checklist.progress: {done} of {total} done. You can leave and come back: this list remembers where you are.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.rateLimited: {name} is rate limiting. It is skipped until {until}.
attention.noKey: No provider key yet, so only free and local tools run.

overview.agentsNone: None yet. Connect one and it shows up here.
overview.runningEmpty: Nothing running. Long tasks such as video show their progress here.
overview.filesEmptyBefore: No files yet. Images, video and audio your tools make are kept here.

plan.ready: Ready: everything {title} needs is set up.

stepsLeft.one: {count} required step left. Free options that run on this computer come first.
stepsLeft.other: {count} required steps left. Free options that run on this computer come first.
